errors.unableToLoadBody: We couldn't reach the server, so readiness and publish history can't be confirmed. Nothing was published or changed.
errors.publishUnexpected: The server didn't confirm the publish. Check Publish history before trying again.

title: Publish centre
subtitle: Generate an auditor-grade PDF, anchor its hash to a public timestamp, and track the assurance workflow.

actions.reviewRepublish: Review and publish a new version

period.title: Reporting period
period.subtitle: {{framework}} — pick a period to publish.
period.none: Create a reporting period for this framework first. Publishing always happens against a period.

readiness.body1: The PDF is generated server-side and each page includes verification on the footer. The cover carries a QR code and a
readiness.shaDef: A 256-bit cryptographic fingerprint of the PDF. Any change to the file — even a single character — produces a different hash, so recipients can prove the file hasn't been altered.
readiness.calendarDef: An external service (OpenTimestamps) that records the hash on the Bitcoin blockchain at a specific moment, providing a tamper-evident proof that the report existed in this exact form on a given date — without trusting Nexus or any single party.
readiness.body3: — any recipient can confirm the file hasn't been modified.
readiness.heading: Publish readiness

history.title: Publish history
history.subtitle: Every prior version is retained, hashed, and externally timestamped.
history.emptyDesc: Approve at least one disclosure in this framework, then review and publish.

assurance.title: Independent assurance workflow
assurance.subtitle1: Send a signed upload link to your audit partner. Once they submit an
assurance.isaeDef: International Standard on Assurance Engagements 3000 — the global standard auditors follow when assuring non-financial information like sustainability data. "Limited" assurance is a moderate level; "Reasonable" is the highest, equivalent to a financial audit.
assurance.subtitle2: opinion, the draft watermark lifts on the next publish.
assurance.emptyDesc: Request assurance from a third-party firm. The platform sends them a private upload link — they don't need a login.

import.successHeadline_one: {{rows}} rows imported · {{count}} disclosure auto-populated and approved
import.successHeadline_other: {{rows}} rows imported · {{count}} disclosures auto-populated and approved
import.noMatch: Import processed but no matching disclosures were updated
import.scope1Def: Direct GHG emissions from sources the company owns or controls — e.g. fuel combusted on-site, company vehicles, refrigerant leaks. GHG Protocol category.
import.scope2Def: Indirect GHG emissions from purchased electricity, steam, heating, or cooling. Reported two ways: location-based (grid average) and market-based (contract-specific).
import.scope3Def: All other indirect emissions across the value chain — split into 15 categories: purchased goods, capital goods, transportation, business travel, employee commuting, use of sold products, end-of-life treatment, investments, etc.

artifact.ixbrlTitle: Download iXBRL (ESRS) — XHTML with embedded inline XBRL tags

assuranceRow.linkHelp: Send this to the auditor. They can upload the signed statement without a platform login.
assuranceRow.confirmRotate: The previous link stops working immediately. Send the new one to the auditor.
assuranceRow.confirmWithdrawBody: The auditor's upload link stops working. You can create a new request at any time.
assuranceRow.copyManually: Copy the link below and send it to the auditor.

modal.title: Request independent assurance
modal.intro: A one-shot upload link will be generated. Copy it and send it to your auditor. They can submit their signed statement without a platform login; the statement is hashed and embedded in the next published version of the report for {{period}}.
modal.created: Assurance request created. Copy the upload link and send it to the auditor.

share.title: Share report publicly
share.intro: Generate a token-protected, read-only URL anyone with the link can view. No login required. The link can be revoked at any time from the audit log.
share.passwordActive: Password protection active. Share the password through a separate channel.
share.readyBody: Anyone with this link can read the published report. It's shown once: copy it now.

checks.approvedSome_other: {{count}} disclosures are not approved yet and will be left out.

checks.anomaliesSome: {{critical}} critical, {{count}} open in total. Resolve or suppress them with a reason.

sheet.title: Publish {{period}}?
sheet.irreversible_one: This generates a PDF of the {{count}} approved disclosure, computes its SHA-256 fingerprint and anchors it to a public timestamp calendar. That can't be undone: this version, its hash and its timestamp stay on the public record. You can publish a newer version later; this one is never deleted.
sheet.irreversible_other: This generates a PDF of the {{count}} approved disclosures, computes its SHA-256 fingerprint and anchors it to a public timestamp calendar. That can't be undone: this version, its hash and its timestamp stay on the public record. You can publish a newer version later; this one is never deleted.
sheet.languageHint: The PDF, Word and iXBRL files are rendered in this language.
sheet.draftWarning: No signed assurance statement for this period: the report will carry a DRAFT watermark until an auditor signs.
sheet.lowCritical_one: {{count}} critical anomaly is still open. Type the period name to confirm you want to publish anyway.
sheet.lowCritical_other: {{count}} critical anomalies are still open. Type the period name to confirm you want to publish anyway.
sheet.lowCoverage: Only {{pct}}% of disclosures are approved. Type the period name to confirm you want to publish anyway.

moment.title: Version {{version}} of {{period}} is published
moment.noHash: The server stored the report but didn't return its fingerprint. You'll find it in Publish history.
moment.anchoredBody: Bitcoin confirmation usually follows within 1–6 hours. The verification page updates on its own.
